assets.sand-albedo-source.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production SOURCE ALBEDO TEXTURE for a strictly overhead 2D North Africa WWII hex tactical tank game. Create a square preferably 1024x1024, full-bleed pale warm beige fine desert SAND MATERIAL, evenly distributed very fine wind ripples and natural tiny grain, very low contrast, restrained natural painterly-realistic strategy-game texture. Camera exactly vertically down, flat diffuse neutral lighting. Average palette pale cream sand approx #D4BD90, with small variations, saturation modest. It is a material for terrain that a continuous hex-elevation contour renderer will shape and light. At a game hex of 40px the sand must remain calm and readable behind tanks. Ripple waves are fine shallow surface texture only, not large crests or hills. Entire image is one continuous material; all areas have similar brightness and feature density, no central composition. Seamless-looking horizontally and vertically, features continue at edges. No baked slope, NO dune silhouette, no large crescent dunes, no crater, no perimeter, no hexagon, no grid, no perspective, no horizon, no stones bigger than tiny grains, no plants, no vehicles, no text, no labels, no transparent border, no directional shadows, no vignette. This is a material source, not a terrain illustration.
assets.limestone-albedo-source.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production SOURCE ALBEDO MATERIAL for a North Africa WWII true-top-down 2D tactical hex game. One square full-bleed preferably 1024x1024 texture, pale sandy limestone BEDROCK with moderate irregular fractured connected plates, occasional small chips and powder in cracks. Uniform natural warm off-white / cream / light dusty taupe palette, not grey volcanic rock. Matte natural painterly-realistic strategy game finish, restrained contrast, diffuse even lighting. Camera 90 degrees vertical, macro texture without perspective. The surface must fill the entire canvas edge to edge and have statistically even density, seamless-looking horizontal and vertical repeats. Thin irregular cracks break the surface into varied irregular 20-80px scale rock plates in a 1024px source, not one giant central stone and not tiny gravel everywhere. This material will be world-space sampled onto contour-generated cliff bands and broad plateau ground; geometry, slope direction, cliff edge and lighting are generated by the renderer. Make no baked cliff, no cliff facade, no raised plateau outline, no hill, no perimeter shadow, no directional lighting, no strong occlusion, no large boulder objects, no grid, no hexes, no text, no border, no transparency, no vegetation, no water. Naturally pale limestone texture, flat neutral illumination.
assets.wadi-silt-albedo-source.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square full-bleed production SOURCE ALBEDO TEXTURE of a DRY WADI FLOOR for a 90-degree overhead 2D North Africa WWII hex tactical game. Prefer 1024x1024. One homogeneous flat ground material, pale dusty cool-beige and light warm taupe compacted alluvial silt, tiny naturally worn rounded pebbles very sparsely embedded, delicate shallow branching surface wash traces, tiny irregular patches of fine sand deposits. Natural painterly-realistic strategy-game texture, modest saturation, low contrast, neutral even diffuse light. Distinguish from golden wind-ripple sand by a slightly cooler silty tone and irregular washed surface, but stay within the same pale desert palette. There is NO water, NO muddy wet sheen, NO dark mud, NO deep cracks resembling salt crust. No composition centered on a river: NO river shape, NO river banks, NO channel outline, NO ravine, NO trench or gully, NO topographic shade, NO central path stripe. The same even material fills the image from edge to edge. The game's existing hex-height system will create the channel and the two banks; this asset must carry material ONLY. Seamless-looking repeat, no vignette, no big stones, no rocks as objects, no grass, no trees, no animals, no text, no grid, no hex outline, no frame, no transparency.
assets.limestone-chips-source.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent 4 x 4 source atlas of 16 individual PALE DESERT LIMESTONE CHIPS for a 90-degree-overhead 2D North Africa tactical hex terrain compositor. Square image, preferably 1024x1024, TRUE ALPHA TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Exactly sixteen separated stones, one stone centered in each of sixteen equally sized cells in a perfectly regular 4-column 4-row arrangement. Invisible grid, no captions. Each stone fully contained in its own cell with generous transparent margins; maximum stone extent 65 percent of cell, no overlap. 16 different natural irregular angular outlines, a mix of flat broken limestone flakes, squat chipped fragments and wedge-like stones, all seen EXACTLY from overhead, no front/side perspective. Pale warm cream, dusty light beige and muted taupe, small subtle surface fractures and tiny facets. Natural lightly painterly strategy-game art. Stone surfaces have mostly neutral even diffuse lighting and restrained facet variation so they can be relit by the game; no strong cast shadows, no ambient shadow painted behind stones, no ground patches, no sand beds, no pebbles around each stone, no foliage, no wetness, no metallic highlights. The transparent gaps MUST remain empty with true alpha, not a checkerboard baked into image. No text, no hexes, no frame, no cell borders. These chips will scatter along existing height-generated rock cliffs; do not generate complete cliffs, rock clusters or terrain tiles.
